name: context-handoff
description: Watches the context window; past a threshold the agent writes a handoff with the next message, then the session compacts and gets it back.

thresholdK.title: Threshold (thousand tokens)
thresholdK.description: Context size, in thousands of tokens, at which the handoff and compaction start. Keep it below the auto-compact window.

carryOrigins.title: Also carry on (origins)
carryOrigins.description: Comma-separated prompt origins, besides messages a person typed, that may carry the handoff request and the restore: peer (subagent hand-backs, other sessions), peer-send-message, task-notification (background tasks, side sessions), scheduled-trigger, coordinator, projects-relay, channel, slack-ping. Empty: typed messages only.

handoffMaxWords.title: Handoff size cap (words)
handoffMaxWords.description: The handoff is asked to stay under this many words; 0 sets no cap.

afterHandoff.title: After the handoff
afterHandoff.description: What follows a written handoff. compact: the session compacts with a minimal summary. clear: the session runs /clear and gets back only the handoff and a record of its last turn (it compacts where the host refuses /clear).

retentionDays.title: Keep handoffs (days)
retentionDays.description: Handoff folders of other sessions untouched for this many days are deleted when a session starts; 0 keeps them forever.
